title: docs(layout): correct retired BreakpointColumnMapSchema attribution and columns type row (objectui#10720)
body:
Fixes #10720
Clause-②: no — a docblock and one reference row are corrected; no declared surface moves

## What changed

Two published-text-only sites, no runtime or code-behaviour change:

1. `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx`'s `ResponsiveGrid` component docblock named the spec's retired `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` as what the component consumes. The same file already declares its own `BreakpointColumnMap` interface earlier (the six keys `xs`…`2xl`), re-homed by objectui#7580 after objectstack#11027 retired the spec export. The docblock now names that local type. Comment only; the diff shows no code line moved.

2. `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`'s `grid` properties table typed `columns` as `number | Record<string, number>` (any string key legal). On `origin/main`, `GridSchema.columns` (declared in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`) is `number | Partial<Record<BreakpointName, number>>`, from objectui#8505/#8519's narrowing. `BreakpointName`, declared in `packages/types/src/mobile.ts`, is the six-member breakpoint union. The zod mirror (`packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`) is narrowed the same way by objectui#8516, as a `z.partialRecord` over the six names. The row now names that type and spells the six keys.

   **No release qualifier added.** Both narrowings are pending release: `.changeset/8505-grid-columns-breakpoint-narrowing.md` and `.changeset/8516-8556-mirror-partial-record-narrowing.md` are on `main`, so the published 17.6.0 still takes an open string-keyed record. The corrected row teaches the narrower shape, and a map written from it is valid on 17.6.0 and on `main` alike. `content/docs/**` carries no per-npm-version convention.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10720-grid-columns-docs.md` — `@object-ui/layout`: patch. The docblock ships in the package's `.d.ts`, so this is a released-surface text change. The docs row needs none (`content/docs/**` is not a published package).

## Serial constraints

Draft PR objectui#8941 also edits `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, inside the `detail-view` JSON example's action `icon` value (the `lucide-react` icon-name bump). That is a different table from this PR's `grid` properties table, with no hunk overlap.
